WITH schools_no_electricity AS (
    SELECT
        "School Code",
        "School Name",
        "Block"
    FROM
        "school_infrastructure"

),

    SELECT

        SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") AS total_students_2024

)

    COUNT(s."School Code") AS number_of_schools,

FROM
    schools_no_electricity s
LEFT JOIN
    enrolment_2024 e ON s."School Code" = e."School Code"
GROUP BY
    s."Block";
